summary: Sandbach United's preseason is in full swing with an exciting new squad taking shape for the 2026/27 campaign, featuring three brand new kits and some fantastic new signings plus a returning player. The Ramblers put in a solid performance against St Helens recently, though fell short on the day, and are now just one week away from the start of the season. The club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities, so if you're interested in backing the team on their promotion push, get in touch via DM!
